messages:
alex: holding rollouts - canary 3 shows token/sec collapse after today's merge
maria: confirmed on perf dashboard. node tok/sec 120k -> 22k, tail latency up. KV cache hit-rate fell 0.86 -> 0.38
cheng: profiler shows kernel path switched to fallback memcpy loop for many batches after the selector change (CL 4732)
alex: @cheng can you paste the kernel decision log?
cheng: paste logs
```
kernel_selector: model=redwood-v1 quant=4bit seq=512 -> chosen=fallback_memcpy (score 0.21)
batcher: heartbeat_delay_ms=120 (+30ms jitter)
kv: local_hitrate=0.39 remote_hitrate=0.02
```
tim: CI note - perf job ctb-throughput failed on main: 25% regen, job id 8942
ci-bot: [perf-ci] ctb-throughput #8942 failed: token/sec regression +24.7% (threshold 10%)
olga: noticed batcher heartbeat jitter increase after the same CL; coalescer waits for heartbeat edge and that introduces extra queueing
alex: seems like kernel selector change nudged different coalesce path and longer beat -> smaller/more fragmented batches -> kv warmup thrash
maria: can we bisect to a single CL? Cheng pointed to 4732 but maybe interaction between 4732 and 4728 (batcher heartbeat tweak)
cheng: running bisection now between 4720..4740
sre-oncall: put rollout on hold cluster-wide. Alerting customers in progress.
cheng: bisection result: reverting 4732 alone does not fully recover; reverting 4728 + 4732 does recover canary tok/sec to ~115k within 5m
tim: created revert PRs: revert/4728 and revert/4732
alex: after applying reverts to canary, metrics back to normal. kv hit-rate returned to 0.82
maria: root cause hypothesis: kernel selector heuristic caused memory-copy fallback for some kernel combos; that path is sensitive to batch alignment which was compounded by heartbeat timing shift -> fragment batches -> kv cache ineffective -> warmup thrash -> tok/sec drop
cheng: follow-ups: add guard in perf CI to run ctb-throughput for the kernel selector change; add unit test for coalescer heartbeat jitter; instrument selector logs to expose score deltas
olga: also add a temporary mitigation: increase coalescer max-wait-ms to absorb jitter until we stabilize selector
alex: opening issues and assigning owners, will coordinate a careful roll-forward after tests
maria: thanks everyone. @sre-oncall once we have a validated patch we'll schedule a canary start
sre-oncall: acknowledged, will watch and stand by
tim: note to docs: add runbook step for similar regression and checklist to verify kv hit-rate during canary
